pages.text: As a Reconstructed Mind evolves into a Proto-Hivemind, it will start building two biomass domes around it. They are made of Biomass Blocks, some of which may inflict negative effects upon being manually mined. However, they constitute a source of Biomass, and are required materials to craft the Creative Motor.
The two biomass domes are centered around the Proto-Hivemind, and have a radius of 15 blocks and 30 blocks each.
